headline: Here’s How Intermodal Demand Is Positioning CSX Corp. (CSX) for Growth
summary: CSX Corp (NASDAQ:CSX) reported better-than-expected results for the second quarter of 2026, thanks to strong intermodal demand. More containers moved by rail rather than truck, along with steady pricing, which helped CSX reach a record revenue of $3.94 billion.
